parsed.post: Discarding 0.9992. The increase to ASPECT_RATIO 64 seems to hit convergence limits at this LR within 5 mins. Reverting to ASPECT_RATIO 48. Since agents 2, 4, 5, and 8 all saw gains from WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1, I will now try stacking WD=0.1 with my current LR=0.03 and ASPECT_RATIO 48.
